name: WISE GISE summer STEM day camp
org: University of Michigan Women in Science and Engineering (WISE)
what_you_do: Spend a week in U-M labs. Pick a morning major. The 2026 choices were Outer Space, Game Design and Biodiversity. In the afternoon, try other subjects with U-M student leaders.
who_can_apply: Students who finish 6th, 7th or 8th grade this school year. Open to all, regardless of sex or gender. No STEM experience needed. Home school students are placed by age.
pay_detail: 2026: $475 for the week, paid after you are accepted. Need based scholarships are on the application. Bring your own lunch.
duration: One week, Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. (June 15 to 19 in 2026). Day camp only, no overnight option.
deadline_text: Applications open February 15 and close May 15. Spots go as applications come in, so apply early. 2027 camp dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online from the WISE GISE page after February 15. You hear back by email about a week after you apply. Questions: umwisegise@umich.edu or (734) 763-5472.
notes: Full refund up to May 15; after that a $100 charge if you cancel. Michigan families can also ask about the Watson A. Young scholarship through U-M YouthHub. Some 6th graders are taken if there is room.
